name: MFP 8 zone repeater panel
family: Context Plus MFP Range Conventional Panels
summary: The Context Plus MFP Repeater panel is designed to mimic the key functions of the MFP Main panel at other parts of a building. These functions include:
description: The Context Plus MFP Repeater panel part FF596 is fitted with one 8 Zone Extender PCB (Part No. FF596R) when supplied. The FF596 Repeater panel can be expanded to 32 zone in multiples of eight by installing extra 8 Zone Extender PCBs (Part No. FF596R).
features: Indicate zones in Fire (up to 32 zones, in multiples of eight)
Allow the user to Reset, Silence and Evacuate
Provide control outputs for Fire and Fault Conditions.
Up to eight Context Plus MFP Repeater panels (Part No. FF596) may be connected to one MFP Main panel with power and communication transmitted using 2 core network cable.
